text:
SY303
Sociology of Youth
0.5 Credit
An examination of adolescence and youth in contemporary society, with reference to such topics as identity, subculture, education, employment, family and the experience of Indigenous youth in Canada.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
One of
SY207
(or SY203*),
SY280
,
SY281
, or
YC100
and
YC200
, (or permission of the department).
